title: 'Only God and the Government': Eerie Jellyfish UFO Raises Questions About What's Coming
excerpt: Osborn was photographing a rainbow in Anchorage, Alaska, on June 15 when something extraordinary caught her attention.
content:
What exactly is lurking in the skies above America’s military bases? And could the growing number of bizarre UFO encounters be pointing toward something far more sinister than anyone realizes?

For one woman who witnessed a mysterious jellyfish-shaped object hovering near an Alaska military base, the answer may rest with two very different authorities: God and the government.

“Only God and the government” may know what she witnessed, according to Sara Jane Osborn, whose strange encounter has added another layer of intrigue to the ongoing UFO mystery.

According to the Daily Mail, as reported by Soapcentral through AOL, Osborn was photographing a rainbow in Anchorage, Alaska, on June 15 when something extraordinary caught her attention.

Hovering above the distant tree line was a dark, jellyfish-shaped object with dangling appendages that appeared to move independently as it rotated. Osborn and her husband, Pete, watched the object for approximately three minutes before it seemingly vanished.

Even more intriguing was its apparent location toward Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, a major U.S. military installation.

“It was very clearly not a kite in its movements,” Osborn told the Daily Mail.

The couple reportedly spent approximately 30 minutes searching for a possible explanation, including whether someone had been flying a kite. They found nothing.

Could it have been a drone, balloons or some other airborne object? Possibly. But no explanation has been confirmed, leaving the mystery surrounding the sighting unresolved.

For Christians watching the increase in discussions around UFOs, the implications could reach far beyond an unexplained object in the sky.

As Charisma Media has previously reported, Christian researcher L.A. Marzulli has warned that humanity may be witnessing the groundwork for what he believes will become one of the greatest spiritual deceptions in history.

“This is the coming great deception,” Marzulli previously told Charisma. “This changes everything.”

Marzulli contends that the entities commonly portrayed as extraterrestrial beings may actually be fallen angels masquerading as visitors from another world. Drawing connections to Genesis 6 and the days of Noah, he believes the UFO narrative could eventually be used to challenge the biblical account of creation itself.

In previous Charisma coverage, Marzulli warned that these supposed visitors could present themselves as humanity’s creators, potentially laying the foundation for a worldwide spiritual deception.

“They will say that they created all life on this planet,” he warned.

Marzulli has also connected alleged UFO encounters to what he believes is an ancient supernatural conflict, one that could become increasingly visible as the world moves closer to the last days.

Jesus warned in Matthew 24:24 that false Christs and false prophets would arise, displaying signs and wonders capable of deceiving even the elect, if possible. Likewise, 2 Thessalonians 2 warns of deceptive signs and wonders accompanying the rise of lawlessness.

For believers, the greater concern may not ultimately be whether something unexplained is flying through the skies, but whether humanity is being conditioned to embrace an explanation that directly contradicts the Word of God.

Because the greatest danger may not be what appears in the sky, but what the world is eventually persuaded to believe about it.
